record_type_quote: We are trying to replicate Huang’s study about cleanliness priming, evaluating whether cleanliness priming affects the severity of a participant’s judgment of moral dilemmas when instructed to do the study quickly. This is the main result in the “Instructed low response effort condition” of Study 2 in Huang, 2014.
